title: Multicenter evaluation of radiomics and multimodal artificial intelligence for colorectal cancer diagnosis and survival prediction
zh_title: 影像组学与多模态 AI 用于结直肠癌诊断与生存预测的多中心评估
summary: 回顾性纳入两中心 879 例，中心 A 训练、中心 B 独立测试，评估 CT 影像组学与多模态融合模型对良恶性分类及生存预测的表现。
key_points: 两中心 879 例，中心 B 独立外部测试
临床-影像组学列线图良恶性分类测试 AUC 0.957
3 年与 5 年总生存影像组学测试 AUC 0.874/0.898
reason: 同行评审且含独立中心外部验证，但为回顾性、仅报告指标，属重要档偏下
abstract: Reliable preoperative classification and outcome prediction could improve management of locally advanced colorectal cancer. We retrospectively studied 879 participants from two centers, including 741 patients with locally advanced colorectal cancer and 138 with benign colorectal lesions. Clinical, radiomics, deep learning, and early fusion models were trained at center A (n = 615) and independently tested at center B (n = 264) using pretreatment contrast-enhanced computed tomography and clinical data. The clinical-radiomics nomogram achieved a test AUC of 0.957 for benign-malignant classification. For 3-year and 5-year overall survival, radiomics achieved test AUCs of 0.874 and 0.898, while fusion achieved 0.870 and 0.899, respectively. These findings identify CT radiomics as a promising digital biomarker for colorectal cancer stratification and show that early deep learning fusion offers limited incremental value over an optimized radiomics baseline.
zh_abstract: 可靠的术前分类和结局预测可改善局部晚期结直肠癌的管理。我们回顾性研究了来自两个中心的879名参与者，包括741例局部晚期结直肠癌患者和138例良性结直肠病变患者。使用治疗前增强计算机断层扫描（CT）和临床数据，在A中心（n = 615）训练临床、影像组学、深度学习和早期融合模型，并在B中心（n = 264）进行独立测试。临床-影像组学列线图在良恶性分类中的测试AUC为0.957。对于3年和5年总生存期，影像组学的测试AUC分别为0.874和0.898，而融合模型分别为0.870和0.899。这些发现表明CT影像组学是一种有前景的用于结直肠癌分层的数字生物标志物，并显示与经过优化的影像组学基线相比，早期深度学习融合仅提供有限的增量价值。

title: GenVinci reconstructs 3D molecular tissue scenes from histology to map senescence across aging and disease
zh_title: GenVinci从组织病理重建三维分子组织场景
summary: 预印本构建含3亿单细胞与空间转录组谱的ImageOmicsNet-300M语料，并发布从常规H&E切片重建三维组织场景的多模态基础模型GenVinci。
key_points: 语料含3亿细胞与空间转录组谱、4623张H&E切片
从2D病理图零样本预测空间基因表达并重建3D场景
覆盖8580万细胞映射衰老相关状态
reason: 大规模病理-组学语料与基础模型公开，属重要档，但为预印本
abstract: Spatial omics has generated measurements at unprecedented scale, yet computational approaches remain largely confined to individual modalities and 2D representations. Here we assemble ImageOmicsNet-300M, a corpus of 300 million single-cell and spatial transcriptomic profiles, including 24.9 million H&E-predicted virtual spatial transcriptomics profiles, and 4,623 H&E sections. Of these H&E sections, we generated 1,782 from aging mouse organs and serially sectioned human skin spanning five decades, with matched spatial transcriptomics and snRNA-seq. Building on this resource, we develop GenVinci, a multimodal tissue foundation model that reconstructs 3D tissue scenes from routine 2D histology. GenVinci predicts spatial gene expression from H&E with zero-shot generalization and maps senescence-associated states across 85.8 million cells, revealing cell-type-specific patterns and disease-associated remodeling. Integration with human genetics implicates suprabasal keratinocytes in atopic dermatitis and keratinocyte carcinomas, linked to higher and lower p16 and p21 expression, respectively. These findings establish GenVinci as a framework mapping senescence in 3D across scales.
zh_abstract: 空间组学已产生前所未有的规模测量，然而计算方法在很大程度上仍局限于单一模态和2D表示。在此，我们构建了ImageOmicsNet-300M，一个包含3亿个单细胞和空间转录组谱的语料库，包括2490万个由H&E预测的虚拟空间转录组谱和4623张H&E切片。在这些H&E切片中，我们生成了1782张来自衰老小鼠器官和跨越五十年的连续切片人类皮肤，并配有匹配的空间转录组学和snRNA-seq。基于这一资源，我们开发了GenVinci，一种多模态组织基础模型，可从常规2D组织学重建3D组织场景。GenVinci从H&E预测空间基因表达，具有零样本泛化能力，并在8580万个细胞中映射衰老相关状态，揭示细胞类型特异性模式和疾病相关重塑。与人类遗传学整合表明基底上层角质形成细胞（suprabasal keratinocytes）参与特应性皮炎和角质形成细胞癌，分别与较高和较低的p16和p21表达相关。这些发现确立GenVinci作为一个跨尺度在3D中映射衰老的框架。

title: Flexible Multi-Stack Super-Resolution of Clinical Brain MRI Using Hetero-Orientation Variational Encoding: Expert Reader Evaluation in a Nigerian Cohort
zh_title: 异向变分编码的多层脑 MRI 超分辨及尼日利亚队列专家阅片评估
summary: 预印本提出序列无关的多层脑 MRI 超分辨率框架 MS-HVED，并在尼日利亚队列中由专家阅片评估。
key_points: 融合轴位、冠状位、矢状位多层图像
采用高斯乘积与视野感知融合
面向资源受限环境的临床协议
reason: 预印本新方法含专家阅片评估，但未经同行评审、证据有限
abstract: High-resolution brain MRI is important for neuroradiological assessment, yet routine clinical protocols often rely on fast, anisotropic 2D acquisitions, particularly in resource-constrained settings. These acquisitions may differ in orientation, alignment and anatomical coverage, resulting in partially overlapping image stacks. Existing learning-based super-resolution methods typically rely on single, under-constrained inputs or fixed multi-stack configurations with idealised acquisition geometry. We introduce MS-HVED, a sequence-agnostic framework for flexible multi-stack brain MRI super-resolution. Available axial, coronal and sagittal stacks are independently encoded into multi-scale Gaussian posteriors and fused using a field-of-view-aware Product-of-Gaussians formulation that limits contributions from unsupported regions. Physics-informed domain randomisation simulates heterogeneous clinical acquisition conditions, including obliqueness, partial coverage and imaging artefacts. MS-HVED achieved competitive or superior reconstruction fidelity across synthetic benchmarks and improved downstream tissue segmentation relative to low-resolution inputs. To assess generalisation beyond the training cohorts, we performed external clinical validation on 30 routine brain MRI examinations from a Nigerian cohort, representing an under-represented population in medical imaging research. These examinations formed the largest component of a blinded reader study involving 44 real cases and seven expert neuroradiologists. In the Nigerian cohort, MS-HVED was preferred over the supervised baseline for overall image quality in 187 of 210 paired assessments. Across all clinical cohorts, MS-HVED achieved higher overall-quality scores with all available inputs (5.93 vs. 4.49, p<.001), with the preference persisting when axial or coronal inputs were omitted (p<.001). Code at github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved
zh_abstract: 高分辨率脑MRI对于神经影像学评估很重要，但常规临床方案往往依赖快速、各向异性的2D采集，尤其是在资源受限环境中。这些采集可能在方向、对齐和解剖覆盖范围上有所不同，导致图像堆栈部分重叠。现有的基于学习的超分辨率方法通常依赖单一的、约束不足的输入，或依赖具有理想化采集几何结构的固定多堆栈配置。我们提出MS-HVED，一种序列无关的框架，用于灵活的多堆栈脑MRI超分辨率。可用的轴位、冠状位和矢状位堆栈被独立编码为多尺度高斯后验，并使用视野感知的高斯乘积（Product-of-Gaussians）公式进行融合，该公式限制无支撑区域的贡献。物理信息引导的域随机化模拟异质性临床采集条件，包括倾斜、部分覆盖和成像伪影。MS-HVED在合成基准上实现了有竞争力或更优的重建保真度，并相对于低分辨率输入改善了下游组织分割。为评估超出训练队列的泛化能力，我们在来自尼日利亚队列的30例常规脑MRI检查上进行了外部临床验证，该队列代表医学影像研究中代表性不足的人群。这些检查构成了涉及44例真实病例和7名专家神经放射科医生的盲法读者研究的最大组成部分。在尼日利亚队列中，MS-HVED在210次配对评估中的187次被优先选择优于监督基线，评价指标为整体图像质量。在所有临床队列中，MS-HVED在使用所有可用输入时获得更高的整体质量评分（5.93 vs. 4.49，p<.001），当省略轴位或冠状位输入时，这种偏好仍然存在（p<.001）。代码见github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved

title: Artificial Intelligence in Lung Diseases: Screening, Diagnosis, Treatment, and Prognosis.
source: PubMed · Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)
zh_title: 人工智能在肺部疾病筛查、诊断、治疗与预后中的应用
summary: 综述性章节，概述 AI 在肺癌、COPD、哮喘、结核、间质性肺病及 COVID-19 等肺部疾病诊疗各环节的应用。
key_points: 覆盖筛查、诊断、治疗与预后多个环节
指出传统依赖医生主观判断的局限
属综述性章节，无原始数据
reason: 综述类文章，无原始数据与新证据，按综述上限内取低档
abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Pulmonary diseases currently pose significant threats to global health, spanning common chronic conditions including lung cancer, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and asthma, as well as infectious and inflammatory diseases like tuberculosis, interstitial lung disease (ILD), and COVID-19. Therefore, accurate diagnosis, effective therapeutic strategies, and reliable assessment of prognosis for pulmonary diseases are essential for improving patient outcomes and safeguarding public health. Despite the increasing availability of medical imaging and pathological data owing to improvements in detection technologies, what is becoming increasingly evident are the limitations of conventional diagnosis, which relies solely on clinicians' subjective judgment based on imaging, pulmonary function, pathology, and clinical experience. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) technology, especially machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), has made significant progress in areas such as image recognition and model construction. Numerous studies have demonstrated the widespread application of AI in the screening and diagnosis of lung diseases, the optimization of treatment strategies, and prognosis assessment, revealing its remarkable ability to process and interpret complex clinical data. Although concerns persist regarding data quality, the "black box" nature of algorithms, clinical practice, and the regulatory landscape, the application of AI in lung disease research and clinical care is more and more promising. In this review, we summarize the latest advances of AI in the diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary diseases, analyze the challenges and limitations of current AI technologies ranging from data and algorithms to clinical translation, and highlight directions for future research.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 肺部疾病目前对全球健康构成重大威胁，涵盖常见慢性疾病，包括肺癌、慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）和哮喘，以及感染性和炎症性疾病，如结核病、间质性肺疾病（ILD）和COVID-19。因此，对肺部疾病进行准确诊断、采取有效治疗策略以及可靠评估预后，对于改善患者结局和保障公共卫生至关重要。尽管随着检测技术的进步，医学影像和病理数据的可及性日益增加，但越来越明显的是，仅依赖临床医生基于影像、肺功能、病理和临床经验的主观判断的传统诊断存在局限性。近年来，人工智能（AI）技术，尤其是机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL），在图像识别和模型构建等领域取得了显著进展。大量研究已证明AI在肺部疾病筛查和诊断、治疗策略优化以及预后评估中的广泛应用，显示出其处理和解释复杂临床数据的显著能力。尽管在数据质量、算法的“黑箱”性质、临床实践和监管环境方面仍存在担忧，但AI在肺部疾病研究和临床照护中的应用正日益具有前景。在本综述中，我们总结了AI在肺部疾病诊断和治疗中的最新进展，分析了当前AI技术从数据和算法到临床转化方面的挑战和局限性，并强调了未来研究方向。

title: AI-Based Anatomy Recognition in Minimally Invasive Kidney Surgery
zh_title: 微创上尿路手术中 AI 解剖结构识别试验注册
summary: 新注册观察性试验，计划入组 1700 例，评估 AI 软件在微创上尿路手术中辅助识别关键解剖结构的效果，尚无结果。
key_points: 观察性设计，计划入组 1700 例

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Chinese PLA General Hospital; conditions: Kidney (Renal Cell) Cancer, Ureteropelvic Junction Obstruction, Upper Urinary Tract Carcinoma; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1700; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study aims to evaluate whether an artificial intelligence (AI) based software system can assist surgeons in identifying key anatomical structures during minimally invasive upper urinary tract surgery. During these procedures, surgeons operate while viewing images from laparoscopic endoscope. Key anatomical structures, such as the kidney, renal artery and vein, ureter, renal pelvis, inferior vena cava, and left reproductive vein, as well as surgical targets such as tumors, may sometimes be difficult to distinguish because of bleeding, surgical smoke, tissue movement, changes in tissue appearance, or obstruction by surgical instruments. The study team has developed an AI-based image recognition system that analyzes surgical video in real time and identifies and outlines relevant anatomical structures on the screen during surgery. The study has two main goals (primary endpoints): 1. To evaluate how accurately the AI system can identify and delineate key anatomical structures in surgical videos collected from different hospitals, surgeons, surgical procedures, and imaging systems. 2. To evaluate the real-time performance and technical reliability of the AI system in the operating room, including processing latency, frame rate, system failure rate, and the proportion of time during surgery in which AI-generated results are successfully displayed. The study will include adults aged 18 years or older who undergo one of five types of minimally invasive upper urinary tract surgery: partial nephrectomy, radical nephrectomy, radical nephroureterectomy, inferior vena cava tumor thrombectomy, or pyeloplasty. The study will be conducted at 11 hospitals in China. In the first phase, surgical videos recorded between 2015 and 2025 will be used to develop, validate, and test the AI system. In the second phase, approximately 100 patients will be prospectively enrolled from internal centers, and the AI-generated anatomical recognition results will be displayed on a monitor during surgery. Overall, approximately 1,600 retrospective surgical cases and 100 prospective cases are planned for inclusion. The AI system is designed solely as an assistive tool for anatomical recognition. It does not make clinical decisions, provide autonomous surgical instructions, or control any surgical equipment. Surgeons remain fully responsible for all clinical and surgical decisions, and the AI display can be turned off at any time. All participants will receive standard clinical care. Parti
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：中国人民解放军总医院；疾病：肾脏（肾细胞）癌、肾盂输尿管连接部梗阻、上尿路癌；类型：OBSERVATIONAL（观察性）；入组：1700；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING（尚未招募）] 本研究旨在评估基于人工智能（AI）的软件系统能否在微创上尿路手术中协助外科医生识别关键解剖结构。在这些手术中，外科医生通过观察腹腔镜内窥镜图像进行操作。关键解剖结构，如肾脏、肾动脉和肾静脉、输尿管、肾盂、下腔静脉和左生殖静脉，以及手术目标如肿瘤，有时可能因出血、手术烟雾、组织移动、组织外观变化或手术器械遮挡而难以区分。研究团队开发了一种基于AI的图像识别系统，可实时分析手术视频，并在手术过程中于屏幕上识别和勾勒相关解剖结构。本研究有两个主要目标（主要终点）：1. 评估AI系统在来自不同医院、外科医生、手术方式和成像系统采集的手术视频中识别和勾画关键解剖结构的准确性。2. 评估AI系统在手术室中的实时性能和技术可靠性，包括处理延迟、帧率、系统故障率，以及手术期间AI生成结果成功显示的时间比例。研究将纳入接受以下五类微创上尿路手术之一的18岁及以上成年人：肾部分切除术、根治性肾切除术、根治性肾输尿管切除术、下腔静脉癌栓取出术或肾盂成形术。本研究将在中国11家医院开展。第一阶段将使用2015年至2025年间记录的手术视频来开发、验证和测试AI系统。第二阶段将从内部中心前瞻性入组约100例患者，并在手术期间于监视器上显示AI生成的解剖识别结果。总体计划纳入约1,600例回顾性手术病例和100例前瞻性病例。AI系统仅设计为解剖识别的辅助工具。它不做出临床决策、不提供自主手术指令，也不控制任何手术设备。外科医生仍对所有临床和手术决策负全部责任，且AI显示可随时关闭。所有参与者将接受标准临床护理。Parti

abstract: The gaze direction of the physician during consultations plays an important role in patient satisfaction, with several studies pointing to the positive correlation between the amount of time the physician spends looking at the patient and patient satisfaction. Additionally, the effects of the virtual consultation environment on the gaze behaviour of the doctor have yet to be studied. Therefore, this study aims to assess the impact of the virtual consultation environment by comparing the amount of total time the doctor spends looking at the patient between face-to-face and virtual consultations, as well as the average duration during the consultation and the gaze frequency. The study population consisted of 14 doctors divided between 4 medical specialties: Gynaecology/Obstetrics (4), Neurology (3), Endocrinology (3) and General and Familiar Medicine (4). A low-cost desktop that runs an appearance-based gaze estimation pipeline was implemented in the clinical setup. Each doctor recorded 20 face-to-face consultations and 20 virtual consultations, which were then processed by the pipeline to obtain the percentage of time the doctor spent looking at the patient during the consultation. Overall, we found that doctors look more at the patient in virtual consultations compared to face-to-face consultations, both in total time and average duration during the consultation. Within medical specialties, three out the four specialties involved presented clear tendencies to look more at the patient in virtual consultations when compared to face-to-face consultations.
zh_abstract: 医生在问诊期间的注视方向对患者满意度起着重要作用，多项研究指出医生看向患者的时间量与患者满意度呈正相关。此外，虚拟问诊环境对医生注视行为的影响尚待研究。因此，本研究旨在通过比较面对面问诊与虚拟问诊中医生看向患者的总时间、问诊期间的平均持续时间以及注视频率，评估虚拟问诊环境的影响。研究人群由14名医生组成，分布于4个医学专科：妇科/产科（4）、神经科（3）、内分泌科（3）和普通与家庭医学（4）。在临床环境中部署了一台低成本台式机，运行基于外观的注视估计流程。每位医生记录了20次面对面问诊和20次虚拟问诊，随后由该流程处理，以获得医生在问诊期间看向患者的时间百分比。总体而言，我们发现与面对面问诊相比，医生在虚拟问诊中看向患者更多，无论是总时间还是问诊期间的平均持续时间。在各医学专科内，涉及的四个专科中有三个表现出明确倾向，即与面对面问诊相比，在虚拟问诊中看向患者更多。
